text.site_description: Luke Watson is a Lubbock, Texas artist and graphic designer. Original wildlife paintings, graphic design, and how to get in touch.
text.hero_lede: Artist, graphic designer, and photographer based in Lubbock, TX.
text.about_p1: Luke Watson is a Lubbock, Texas–based artist, graphic designer, and photographer who specializes in a variety of mediums including acrylic, spray paint, graphite, and more. He is a real estate photographer in the Lubbock area by day and a visual artist by night and enjoys camping, hiking, and astrophotography in his spare time.
text.art_intro: Originals are one of one — reach out below for pricing and availability.
text.contact_intro: Commission a piece, order a print, book Luke for a project, or just say hi — fill out the form and he'll get back to you.
